<awtsmoosMeluketTranslation heichel="ikar" alias="meluket_translation_en" seriesId="טבת_meluket" postId="BH_POST_1766518916134_theRebbe_917" batchId="meluket-_D7_98_D7_91_D7_AA_meluket__BH_POST_1766518916134_theRebbe_917__p007">
  <section v="18">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section explains how Torah and prayer correspond to the higher and lower levels of Daas, and how Yehudah's approach unites them.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">10)</t>
    <t s="1">And 4)</t>
    <t s="2">Based on this, we can explain the connection of "Vayigash eilav Yehudah" to the union of the two intellects,</t>
    <t s="3">the higher Daas and the lower Daas,</t>
    <t s="4">for the two matters of Torah and prayer are in the manner of higher Daas and lower Daas.</t>
    <t s="5">For in addition to the fact that Torah is from above downward and prayer is from below upward</t>
    <t s="6">(for higher Daas is from above downward and lower Daas is from below upward53),</t>
    <t s="7">[there is also the fact] that Torah is drawn into the intellect of man as it is in his [own] existence</t>
    <t s="8">(for although man's intellect is incomparable to the Torah,</t>
    <t s="9">nevertheless, in order for man's intellect to understand and grasp the Torah he learns, he does not need to depart from his [own] existence)</t>
    <t s="10">and even then it is the word of Hashem54,</t>
    <t s="11">meaning that the drawing down of Torah below is not according to the limitations of the lower realm, but rather from the aspect of the Torah itself</t>
    <t s="12">(since it is without limit, it is drawn into every place),</t>
    <t s="13">this indicates that in the drawing down of Torah, the creations do not occupy a place — this is higher Daas, where</t>
    <t s="14">(above there is a "yesh" [existence], and)</t>
    <t s="15">below there is nothing.</t>
    <t s="16">And [the fact] that the drawing down of prayer is from the aspect of the elevation of the lower realm's service</t>
    <t s="17">("You desire the work of Your hands"),</t>
    <t s="18">and also that its subject is to change the creations,</t>
    <t s="19">indicates that in this drawing down, the lower realm occupies a place — this is lower Daas, where below there is a "yesh."</t>
    <t s="20">And through Yehudah's plea "Bi Adoni,"</t>
    <t s="21">which is like the matter of the verse "Ad-nai, open my lips, and my mouth will declare Your praise" recited before prayer</t>
    <t s="22">(as above in section 3),</t>
    <t s="23">his prayer</t>
    <t s="24">(the prayer of man)</t>
    <t s="25">was in such a manner that through it, the prayer of the Holy One, blessed be He, was drawn down,</t>
    <t s="26">[so that] even the drawing down through his prayer,</t>
    <t s="27">whose subject is to make a change in the lower realm,</t>
    <t s="28">was in a manner that the drawing down from above was revealed within it</t>
    <t s="29">(from above the chain of descent),</t>
    <t s="30">[this is] the union of the two intellects.</t>
  </section>
  <section v="19">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section explains that when prayer incorporates the advantage of Torah, it surpasses Torah, just as lower Daas illuminated by higher Daas surpasses higher Daas.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">And based on what was explained above</t>
    <t s="1">(section 4)</t>
    <t s="2">that prayer is above Torah</t>
    <t s="3">[for Torah is analogous to the matter of "lower and lower," etc., and prayer is analogous to the matter of "higher and higher," etc.],</t>
    <t s="4">and the advantage of Torah relative to prayer is that the drawing down of Torah is a drawing down of Elokus,</t>
    <t s="5">it can be said</t>
    <t s="6">that when prayer is in a manner that also contains the advantage of Torah,</t>
    <t s="7">then prayer is above Torah.</t>
    <t s="8">And similarly, regarding higher Daas and lower Daas,</t>
    <t s="9">when lower Daas is in a manner that the revelation of higher Daas also shines within it,</t>
    <t s="10">then it is above higher Daas.</t>
    <t s="11">And similarly, regarding Zeir Anpin and Malchus,</t>
    <t s="12">which are higher Daas and lower Daas</t>
    <t s="13">(as above in section 2),</t>
    <t s="14">[it is] that through Malchus becoming like Zeir Anpin</t>
    <t s="15">(both equal),</t>
    <t s="16">this is a preparation for the revelation of the source of Malchus, which is above the source of Zeir Anpin.</t>
    <t s="17">Therefore, in the union of the two intellects in "Vayigash eilav Yehudah," there is also concealed the elevation of Malchus that will be in the future,</t>
    <t s="18">that Malchus will be above Zeir Anpin,</t>
    <t s="19">"A woman of valor is the crown of her husband."</t>
  </section>
</awtsmoosMeluketTranslation>
